title: industrial
code:
setcpm(120/4)
const DRUMS = "dmx"
const DRUMS2 = "akaixr10"
const BASS = "gm_acoustic_bass"
const KEYS = "piano"
$drum_track:stack(
  sound("bd ~ bd bd ~ bd ~ ~").bank(DRUMS).gain(.5),
  sound("~ ~ sd ~ [~ sd] ~ sd ~").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.6).room(.5),
  sound("hh hh hh - hh hh - hh").bank(DRUMS).gain(saw.range(0.3,0.6).slow(4)),
  sound("~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ oh ~").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.5),
  sound("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [[lt lt lt] lt mt ht]").bank(DRUMS2).gain(0.2).slow(4),
  sound("cr ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.6).slow(2),
  //sound("rd*8").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.4)
).gain(0.3)

$bass:stack(
s("saw").seg(16).n(irand(12)).scale("F1:minor")
.penv(48).panchor(0).pdec(0.05)
.delay(0.25).room(0.25)
.compressor(-20).vib(0.3)
.partials(randL(200))
.phases(randL(200))
  ).gain(0.3)

title: progression
code:
setcpm(120/4)
const DRUMS = "dmx"
const DRUMS2 = "akaixr10"
const BASS = "gm_synth_bass_1"
const KEYS = "piano"
const STRINGS = "gm_synth_strings_1"
const STRINGS_SCALE = "<bb:major C:minor Eb:major>*16"//Eb:major  C:minor F:dorian
//const STRINGS_SCALE = "C:minor//Eb:major  C:minor F:dorian
//const STRINGS_SCALE = "F:dorian"//Eb:major   
//const STRINGS_SCALE = "Eb:major"//  C:minor F:dorian

$: note("<[c2 c3]*4 [bb1 bb2]*4 [f2 f3]*4 [eb2 eb3]*4>")
.sound(BASS).lpf(800)

$: n(`<
[~ 0] 2 [0 2] [~ 2]
[~ 0] 1 [0 1] [~ 1]
[~ 0] 3 [0 3] [~ 3]
[~ 0] 2 [0 2] [~ 2]
>*4`).scale(STRINGS_SCALE)
.sound(STRINGS)

$: sound("bd*4, [~ <sd cp>]*2, [~ hh]*4")
.bank(DRUMS)

title: Pop song — full arrangement
desc: I–V–vi–IV progression with supersaw chords and a bright lead.
code:
setcpm(120/4)

stack(
  sound("bd*2 ~ bd ~").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.9),
  sound("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.8),
  sound("hh*8").bank("RolandTR909").gain(0.4).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),

  note("c2 c2 a1 f1").sound("sawtooth").lpf(800).gain(0.7).room(0.2),

  note("<[c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4] [a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4]>")
    .sound("supersaw").lpf(sine.range(600,2000).slow(8))
    .gain(0.5).room(0.4).attack(0.05),

  note("e5 g5 c6 g5 ~ a5 g5 e5")
    .sound("triangle").gain(0.45)
    .delay(0.3).delaytime(0.25).room(0.3).slow(2)
)

title: Prog rock drum kit
desc: Full kit: syncopated kick, ghost-note snare, tom fills, ride swap.
code:

const DRUMS = "compurhythm1000"
$drum_track:stack(
  sound("bd ~ bd bd ~ bd ~ ~").bank(DRUMS).gain(1),
  sound("~ ~ sd ~ [~ sd] ~ sd ~").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.85).room(.5),
  sound("hh*8").bank(DRUMS).gain(saw.range(0.3,0.6).slow(4)),
  sound("~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ oh ~").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.5),
  sound("~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [lt mt ht]").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.7).slow(4),
  sound("cr ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.6).slow(2),
  sound("rd*8").bank(DRUMS).gain(0.4).mask("<0 0>")
)
